decisions.statement: An artist's slug is the artist's name slugged.
A catalogue page's slug is the artist's slug followed by the slugged title.
A name is folded into a stem by `page-stem` rather than folded here.
A slug runs to the hundred characters a page's slug holds.
A name past that length is shortened to whole words rather than refused.
A name whose first word fills the length on its own is shortened mid-word.
A colliding slug's number is fitted inside that length rather than added past that length.
A colliding slug is the base followed by a number.
The first number a colliding slug is offered is the number two.
A number another slug already has gives way to the next number up.
A base a thousand slugs already have is thrown rather than numbered again.
An existing page keeps the name that page already has.
A page is recognised as existing by the external id that page was filed under.
A name given out in a run is taken for the rest of that run.
Nothing here reads the page store.

definition: the name a page in the catalogue is reached by
